subject: Transportation Systems
title: London's Metropolitan Railway
description: A micro-lesson that makes London's Metropolitan Railway usable.

hook.text: In 1863, London opened the world's first underground railway. Passengers rode through gas-lit tunnels.

buildup.text: The Metropolitan Railway used steam locomotives. Smoke and soot filled the tunnels within minutes.

discovery.text: Engineers added ventilation shafts, but riders still choked. The experience was miserable—yet popular.

twist.text: 38,000 people rode it on opening day. London was so congested that even a smoky tunnel beat the streets.

climax.text: Within a decade, dozens of companies were digging new lines. The Tube network was taking shape.

punchline.text: The world's first subway ran on steam and hope.

quiz.question: What powered the world's first underground railway?
